about: The paragraph motions, measured against vim 9.2 on 2026-11-14 — the last open divergence, now closed. `}`/`{` are EXCLUSIVE linewise: the operator takes whole lines but not the line the motion lands on. The subtlety is at end of buffer: an exclusive motion ending at EOF is backed off by one character first, which changes the SHAPE when the range starts on the last line — `Gd}` EMPTIES that line (leaving an empty last line) while `Gdd`/`GdG` REMOVE it; and a linewise run to EOF takes the newline before it, so no trailing empty line survives.
